definitions.explanation: An area far from the center of civilization, often near national borders or in sparsely populated territory.

examples.japanese: {辺境|へんきょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{村|むら}→村：02261_mura⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{訪|おとず}れた→訪れる：07678_otozureru⟧。
examples.english: I visited a village in a remote region.

examples.japanese: {辺境|へんきょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{地|ち}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{医療|いりょう}→医療：01836_iryou⟧⟦サービス→サービス：01531_saabisu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{不足|ふそく}→不足：03598_fusoku⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Medical services are lacking in frontier regions.

examples.japanese: ⟦かつて→かつて：10303_katsute⟧ローマ⟦{帝国|ていこく}→帝国：12420_teikoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{辺境|へんきょう}だった⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{古代|こだい}→古代：05324_kodai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{要塞|ようさい}→要塞：14157_yousai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{跡|あと}→跡：02174_ato⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{残|のこ}っている→残る：01187_nokoru⟧。
examples.english: In this region, once on the frontier of the Roman Empire, ruins of ancient fortresses still remain.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{辺|へん}→辺：00937_hen⟧ (periphery, edge) + {境|きょう} (border, boundary).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {辺境|へんきょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{地|ち} (a remote land)
- {辺境|へんきょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{村|むら}→村：02261_mura⟧ (a frontier village)
- {辺境|へんきょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧ (to defend the frontier)
- {辺境|へんきょう}{伯|はく} (margrave — a feudal title)

USAGE:
Often used in historical, geographical, and fantasy contexts. In fantasy fiction, {辺境|へんきょう} frequently describes the remote edges of a kingdom. The term carries a sense of distance from power and civilization.
